purpose: Deterministic band table for the RIG lattice A1-A4 process layer. Any task, given four routing inputs plus one shape input, maps to exactly one build mode (A1-A4) with required gates. No LLM in the routing decision path.

stakes.definition: Cost of being wrong: money, brand, contracts, or a compounding stock (attention, pipeline, trust) burned while unsolved.

reversibility.definition: Can the artifact be undone cheaply after ship? yes = re-run/branch/backup restores prior state; no = one-way door (public claim, sent message, migrated data, spent money).

evidence_density.bucket: floor(evidence_density + 0.5)  // round half UP; never Python banker's rounding (see failure modes)
evidence_density.definition: Share of the task's grounding already present: data files, corpus, prior runs, requester-given facts. 0.9 = corpus fully mounted; 0.3 = mostly unknown.

outward_action.definition: The task ends in deploy/send/publish/pay/delete/migrate - any irreversible external side effect. true forces band B4 and Gate-D regardless of index.

shape_floor.note: Lattice-local extension of the four canonical inputs (RIG_DOCTRINE.md section 4 routing signatures, made lookup-shaped). The minimum intelligence the TASK itself requires, independent of consequence weight.

signatures.a1: Known task, deterministic, low risk, no reasoning needed, repeatable script possible (fixed rules/thresholds produce the artifact).
signatures.a2: Drafting/transformation; Python can validate the output against a typed schema; the LLM call is single-shot and bounded.
signatures.a3: Multi-step workflow, tool use required, ambiguous intent, mechanism map needed, retries with feedback.
signatures.a4: Novel strategy, contradictory evidence, open-ended research, red-team or falsification needed.

scoring.final_mode: mode = max(shape_floor, gate_mode_floor)  // the MINIMUM mode satisfying both task shape and consequence governance; A1-first means never start above it
scoring.bms_confidence_crosscheck: If the mission packet already carries a doctrine BMS confidence score (0-1), route shape directly per RIG_DOCTRINE.md section 4: >=0.75 -> a1, 0.45-0.74 -> a2, 0.25-0.44 -> a3, <0.25 -> a4. The two selectors must agree; disagreement is a routing smell, resolve by taking the higher floor and recording why.

table.rationale: Reversible, low stakes, well-grounded: fast lane, deterministic.
Thin evidence but nothing at risk and fully undoable: measure cheaply in A1, mark Unknowns.
Low stakes with partial undo: still fast lane; snapshot before write.
Low stakes, thin grounding: cheap probe, no gating weight needed.
One-way door but stakes low and grounding good: proceed deterministically, log the door.
Irreversible with thin evidence: add one bounded validation pass before committing.
Meaningful stakes but trivially undoable and grounded: standard lane.
Undoable medium stakes, thin evidence: gather evidence in A1 first.
Medium stakes, partial undo, grounded: fast lane with artifact retained.
Medium stakes + partial undo + thin grounding: schema-validated hybrid.
One-way door at medium stakes with decent grounding: bounded mode with diff/replay checks.
Irreversible, medium stakes, thin evidence: governed agent with mechanism map and audit.
High stakes but fully reversible and grounded: still deterministic; reversibility is the cheap insurance.
High stakes, thin evidence, but undoable: bounded hybrid to close evidence gaps fast.
High stakes + partial undo: hybrid with output diffing against the retained original.
High stakes, partially irreversible, thin evidence: governed agent, guardrails on.
High stakes one-way door, decent grounding: adversarial verification before the door.
High stakes, irreversible, ungrounded: full free-agent treatment, red-team, Gate-D on any outward step.

B1.rationale: Nothing expensive can go wrong. Speed and replayability dominate; deterministic code is both faster and auditable.
escalation_triggers: A1 returns UNKNOWN for a required judgment -> route to A3.1 bounded probe (canonical: RIG_A1_A4_ARCHETYPES.md rule; if the UNKNOWN is a single schema-shaped judgment, an A2 wrapper is the cheaper intermediate - record which was chosen)
de_escalation_triggers: N/A - already the floor; A1 stays A1 until it returns UNKNOWN

B2.gate: typed-schema validation + output diffing + capped token budget
B2.rationale: A model earns its place only inside a deterministic wrapper: forced structure, validated, diffable, with an A1 fallback path.
escalation_triggers: Schema validation fails on 2 consecutive attempts (A2 confidence collapse -> A3, canonical)
Decomposition count > 3: the task needs more than three sub-judgments chained -> multi-step governed workflow
evidence_density drops below 0.40 mid-flight (grounding eroded; the bounded call is now guessing)
de_escalation_triggers: Output contract stabilizes across 3 runs (same schema, same fields) -> encode as A1 template/rule and replay
A2 call becomes unnecessary because the deterministic path now covers it

B3.gate: state object + tool allowlist + cost/runtime budget + guardrail result + audit row + approval packet on transitions
B3.rationale: Multi-step agency with real teeth on failure: every transition visible, every retry logged, a named escalation path.
escalation_triggers: Unresolved ambiguity after the bounded budget (two failed map widenings, guardrail conflict, discriminator cannot be instrumented) -> A3 unresolved ambiguity escalates to A4 (canonical)
Any outward action emerges mid-flight -> freeze, re-route to B4, Gate-D before the action
de_escalation_triggers: Procedure proven across runs -> re-implement as A2 schema chain or A1 rule; keep the agent only for the residue
Ambiguity resolved by a single new measurement -> drop to A2 to apply it

B4.gate: Gate-D (typed human approval, APPROVE <run_id>) + kill switch + budget switch + audit log + red-team review
B4.rationale: Outward and/or one-way-door at high stakes: exploration may be free, but the ACT is not - a human types the approval.
escalation_triggers: A4 exploration proposes an outward step not covered by the existing approval packet -> new Gate-D with exact target/scope/values
de_escalation_triggers: Strategy fixed -> execution drops to A3 governed run
Plan encoded -> replayable steps drop to A2/A1 (canonical: A4 requires A1/A2/A3 fallbacks)

doctrine.a1_first: Never start at A3/A4 when A1/A2 suffices. The computed mode is the minimum satisfying shape_floor and gate_mode_floor; anything above it needs a recorded reason.
doctrine.never_skip_a1: Universal rule 1 (RIG_DOCTRINE.md): every A2/A3/A4 run still opens with its deterministic prelude (files present, inputs valid, checks runnable).
doctrine.fallback_independence: Universal rule 11: A2/A3/A4 failure must never break the A1 fallback (degraded-but-honest beats silently unreasoned).
doctrine.unknown_not_guess: A1 returns UNKNOWN instead of guessing; invention is reserved for modes that can be held accountable for it.
